content:
alex g: Heads-up — product wants a 1k-token unit-cost view in the console next week. Need to align on what runtime/infra signals we can actually ship to the dashboard.

maria chen: Thanks. We want: cost_per_1k_tokens, cache_savings_pct, batching_savings_pct, and a breakdown by model + route. Also filters for region and deployment tier. UX: chart + top contributors table.

jon parker: From runtime we can emit: `tokens_generated`, `tokens_served_cached`, `batch_size`, `request_count`, `gpu_time_ms`. Aggregation is the tricky part (where to derive the per-1k metric).

alex g: Thinking: store raw counters in telemetry pipeline and derive the unit metric in OLAP. Keep ingest simple (low cardinality). What labels do you need?

maria chen: Model, route, rollout_tag, region. We can drop full request_id at ingest — too noisy.

jon parker: Agreed. Runtime can attach `model`, `route`, `region`, `rollout` with each event. Example event shape we can emit via kafka: `{ "metric": "tokens_generated", "value": 345, "model": "redwood-3b", "route": "chat", "region": "us-west-2", "rollout": "canary-v2" }`. We'll batch these per request.

katie li: Question on cache savings: do we send a boolean hit per token or aggregated per request? Per-token is high-cardinality. Better to emit per-request counters: `tokens_generated` and `tokens_served_cached`. Then the pipeline computes saved_tokens = sum(tokens_served_cached).

samir r: Pipeline note — we need stable metric names for long-term dashboards. Suggest `metric=token.generated`, `metric=token.cached_served`, `metric=request.batch_size`, `metric=gpu.ms`. Also emit `ingest_shard` for debugging but not for dashboards.

alex g: Good. Also we need to agree on formula for cost_per_1k. Proposal: cost_per_1k = (sum(gpu_cost_ms) + sum(compute_other_costs)) / (sum(tokens_generated) / 1000). We only have precise GPU time; other infra costs will be modeled per-deployment later.

maria chen: That works. For the dashboard we also want cache_savings_pct = 100 * (1 - (tokens_generated - tokens_cached) / tokens_generated) — or more simply 100 * tokens_cached / tokens_generated.

jon parker: Will emit both counters. Note: for streaming responses KV cache hits happen mid-stream; we accumulate `tokens_served_cached` as we go.

katie li: Batching savings: we should capture `effective_batch_size` histogram or counters `batch_size` and `batch_count` so OLAP can compute average savings. For a simple metric: batching_savings_pct = 1 - (cost_with_batching / cost_without_batching) — but we don't have a direct cost_without_batching. Instead we can use proxies: per-token GPU time vs per-token GPU time when batch_size=1.

samir r: Telemetry ingestion changes: metrics-ingest will accept proto JSON, low-cardinality labels only. We'll add a new topic `telemetry.tokens.v1`. Backfill is not required.

alex g: Who owns the OLAP derivation + dashboards? Eng-platform for the metrics + product owns UX. Need a small ownership doc for rollouts.

maria chen: Product will own the console visuals and queries. Eng-platform will provide materialized tables: `tokens_by_model_route_day` with columns: model, route, region, rollout, day, sum_tokens_generated, sum_tokens_cached, sum_gpu_ms, sum_batch_count. That should be enough.

jon parker: Implementation notes for runtime:

```
emit({metric: "token.generated", value: tokens_generated, labels: {model, route, region, rollout}})
emit({metric: "token.cached_served", value: tokens_served_cached, labels: {model, route, region, rollout}})
emit({metric: "request.batch_size", value: batch_size, labels: {model, route, region, rollout}})
```
We'll throttle to one message per request.

katie li: Concern: cardinality explosion if rollout tag includes hashes. Enforce `rollout` <= 32 chars and map long ids to `canary`/`stable` at runtime if needed.

alex g: Agreed. Also a routing policy corner: if fallback model used due to capacity, we must surface `route_fallback_model` label so dashboards can attribute higher/lower cost.

samir r: I'll add `fallback_model` optional label (nullable) and a `capacity_tier` label (hosted/dedicated/private).

infra-bot: Deploy triggered: `metrics-ingest` PR #342 merged to canary. :rocket:

alex g: OK next steps: Jon/Katie implement emit in runtime (PR this week). Samir will wire ingest topic and materialized table schema. Maria/product will mock dashboard queries and UX. I'll sync Friday for a quick demo. Thanks all :thumbsup:
